# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:tools` from src/tools. Do not edit by hand. -->

The MCP server provides **154 tools**. Access levels: `read` (always on), `write` (on by default), `destructive` and `admin` (off by default, see [CONFIGURATION.md](CONFIGURATION.md)). Tools marked _confirm_ need an explicit user confirmation for every call.

Most repository tools take optional `owner` and `repo`; when omitted they are taken from the git remote of the current working directory that points to the configured Gitea server. Every tool accepts an optional `profile`.

## Connection

| Tool              | Access | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Parameters |
| ----------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| `connection_test` | read   | Checks the connection to the configured Gitea server: reachability, TLS, token validity, the authenticated user, the Gitea version, which optional API features the server supports and which read scopes the token grants. Use this first when setting up or when other tools fail with authentication errors. | –          |
| `profiles_list`   | read   | Lists the configured Gitea profiles (server URLs, whether a token is set, read-only flag) and the enabled operation levels. Tokens are never shown.                                                                                                                                                             | –          |

| --------------------- | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `repo_list`           | read                 | Lists repositories. Without `owner` it lists all repositories the authenticated user can access (own, collaborations, organisations). With `owner` it lists the repositories of that user or organisation.                                                                                    | `limit`, `page`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `repo_search`         | read                 | Searches repositories on the server by keyword (name and optionally description), topic, visibility and archive state, with sorting.                                                                                                                                                          | `query`, `topic`, `include_description`, `private`, `archived`, `mode`, `sort`, `order`, `limit`, `page`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `repo_get`            | read                 | Returns repository metadata: visibility, default branch, counters, enabled units, merge settings, topics, languages and your permissions.                                                                                                                                                     | –                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `repo_create`         | write                | Creates a new repository for the authenticated user or, with `organization`, inside an organisation. Repositories are private by default. Needs the token scope write:user (own account) or write:organization (organisation).                                                                | `name`, `organization`, `description`, `private`, `auto_init`, `default_branch`, `gitignores`, `license`, `readme`, `template`                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `repo_update`         | write                | Edits repository settings such as description, website, default branch, enabled units (issues, wiki, pull requests, actions, releases, projects) and allowed merge styles. Visibility and archive state have dedicated tools because they need confirmation.                                  | `description`, `website`, `default_branch`, `has_issues`, `has_wiki`, `has_pull_requests`, `has_actions`, `has_releases`, `has_projects`, `has_packages`, `allow_merge_commits`, `allow_rebase`, `allow_rebase_explicit`, `allow_squash_merge`, `allow_fast_forward_only_merge`, `default_merge_style`, `default_delete_branch_after_merge`, `template` |
| `repo_set_visibility` | write, confirm       | Makes a repository private or public. Making a repository public exposes its code, issues and history to everyone, so the user must confirm.                                                                                                                                                  | `private`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `repo_archive`        | write, confirm       | Archives a repository (read-only: no pushes, issues or pull requests) or unarchives it. Requires user confirmation.                                                                                                                                                                           | `archived`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `repo_delete`         | destructive, confirm | PERMANENTLY deletes a repository including code, issues, pull requests, releases and wiki. This cannot be undone. Requires destructive operations to be enabled and an explicit user confirmation naming the repository.                                                                      | –                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `repo_fork`           | write                | Forks a repository into your account or into an organisation, optionally under a new name.                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `organization`, `name`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `repo_forks_list`     | read                 | Lists the forks of a repository.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | `limit`, `page`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `repo_topics_set`     | write                | Replaces the topics of a repository (lowercase, digits and dashes).                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `topics`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `file_get`            | read                 | Reads a file from a repository at a branch, tag or commit. Text is returned decoded; binary files return metadata only. Directories return their listing.                                                                                                                                     | `path`, `ref`, `max_chars`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `dir_list`            | read                 | Lists the entries of a directory (default: repository root) at a ref.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `path`, `ref`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

| `files_find`          | read                 | Finds files whose path matches a glob pattern (e.g. "**/\*.ts", "src/**/config.*") or contains a substring.                                                                                                                                                                                   | `pattern`, `ref`, `limit`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `code_search`         | read                 | Searches file contents for a text (or regular expression) and returns matching lines with line numbers. The Gitea API has no code-search endpoint, so this scans files via the API: narrow it with `path_glob` for large repositories. Files larger than 512 KB and binary files are skipped. | `query`, `regex`, `case_sensitive`, `path_glob`, `ref`, `max_files`, `max_matches`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `file_create`         | write                | Creates a new file with the given text content in one commit.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `path`, `content`, `branch`, `new_branch`, `message`, `author_name`, `author_email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `file_update`         | write                | Replaces the content of an existing file in one commit. The current blob SHA is looked up automatically if not supplied; pass `sha` to guard against concurrent changes.                                                                                                                      | `path`, `content`, `sha`, `from_path`, `branch`, `new_branch`, `message`, `author_name`, `author_email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `file_delete`         | destructive, confirm | Deletes a file in a new commit. Requires destructive operations and user confirmation.                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `path`, `sha`, `branch`, `new_branch`, `message`, `author_name`, `author_email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `files_commit`        | write                | Creates, updates, renames and deletes several files in a single commit. For updates and deletes the current SHA is resolved automatically. Deleting files through this tool requires destructive operations to be enabled.                                                                    | `files`, `branch`, `new_branch`, `message`, `author_name`, `author_email`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

| Tool                       | Access               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Parameters                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| -------------------------- | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |

| `branch_list`              | read                 | Lists the branches of a repository with their latest commit and protection status.                                                                                                                                                                              | `limit`, `page`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

| `branch_delete`            | destructive, confirm | Deletes a branch. Commits that are not merged elsewhere become unreachable. | `compare`                  | read                 | Compares two branches, tags or commits (base...head): lists the commits head is ahead by and the files they change. With include_diff, unified diffs of the changed files are computed (up to max_diff_files).                                                  | `base`, `head`, `include_diff`, `max_diff_files`, `max_diff_chars`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `commit_list`              | read                 | Lists commits of a branch/ref, optionally filtered by path and date range. | `commit_get`               | read                 | Returns a commit with message, author, stats and changed files; set include_diff for the patch.                                                                                                                                                                 | `sha`, `include_diff`, `max_diff_chars`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `commit_history_analyze`   | read                 | Analyses recent commit history of a ref: commits per author, Conventional Commit types, breaking changes, activity by day and date range.                                                                                                                       | `ref`, `since`, `until`, `path`, `max_commits`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

| `tag_list`                 | read                 | Lists tags with the commit they point to.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `limit`, `page`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

| `tag_create`               | write                | Creates a tag (annotated when a message is given) on a branch or commit.                                                                                                                                                                                        | `tag`, `target`, `message`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `tag_delete`               | destructive, confirm | Deletes a tag. Releases that use it lose their tag. ## Issues, labels and milestones

| Tool                   | Access               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Parameters                                                                                                                                          |
| ---------------------- | -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `issue_list`           | read                 | Lists issues of a repository filtered by state, labels, milestone, keyword, author, assignee and mentions. Use `priority` to filter by priority labels (e.g. "priority/high", "P1").                                                                  | `state`, `labels`, `milestones`, `query`, `created_by`, `assigned_to`, `mentioned`, `since`, `before`, `priority`, `include_pulls`, `limit`, `page` |
| `issue_search`         | read                 | Searches issues and pull requests across all repositories you can access, e.g. everything assigned to you or mentioning you.                                                                                                                          | `query`, `state`, `type`, `labels`, `assigned`, `created`, `mentioned`, `review_requested`, `since`, `before`, `limit`, `page`                      |
| `issue_get`            | read                 | Returns an issue (or pull request) with its description and, optionally, its comments.                                                                                                                                                                | `number`, `include_comments`, `max_comments`                                                                                                        |
| `issue_create`         | write                | Creates an issue with optional labels (names), assignees, milestone (title) and due date.                                                                                                                                                             | `title`, `body`, `labels`, `assignees`, `milestone`, `due_date`, `ref`                                                                              |
| `issue_update`         | write                | Edits title, body, assignees (replaces the list), milestone, due date or state (open/closed) of an issue or pull request. Labels are changed with issue_labels.                                                                                       | `number`, `title`, `body`, `assignees`, `milestone`, `remove_milestone`, `due_date`, `remove_due_date`, `state`                                     |
| `issue_set_state`      | write                | Closes or reopens an issue, optionally adding a comment explaining why.                                                                                                                                                                               | `number`, `state`, `comment`                                                                                                                        |
| `issue_assign`         | write                | Adds or removes assignees of an issue or pull request without touching the others.                                                                                                                                                                    | `number`, `add`, `remove`                                                                                                                           |
| `issue_labels`         | write                | Adds, removes or replaces labels of an issue or pull request. Labels may be given by name.                                                                                                                                                            | `number`, `add`, `remove`, `replace`                                                                                                                |
| `issue_comment_create` | write                | Adds a comment (Markdown) to an issue or pull request.                                                                                                                                                                                                | `number`, `body`                                                                                                                                    |
| `issue_comment_list`   | read                 | Lists the comments of an issue or pull request.                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `number`, `since`, `before`, `limit`                                                                                                                |
| `issue_comment_update` | write                | Edits the text of an existing issue or pull request comment.                                                                                                                                                                                          | `comment_id`, `body`                                                                                                                                |
| `issue_comment_delete` | destructive, confirm | Deletes an issue or pull request comment. Requires confirmation.                                                                                                                                                                                      | `comment_id`                                                                                                                                        |
| `issues_summary`       | read                 | Analyses the issues of a repository (default: all open issues) and summarises them by priority, label, assignee, milestone and age, lists stale issues and the most important open tasks. Use for "analyse all open issues" or "show all open tasks". | `state`, `labels`, `milestone`, `max_issues`                                                                                                        |
| `label_list`           | read                 | Lists the labels of a repository (and of its organisation, if any).                                                                                                                                                                                   | –                                                                                                                                                   |
| `label_create`         | write                | Creates a repository label. Names with a slash and `exclusive` form scoped label groups (e.g. "priority/high").                                                                                                                                       | `name`, `color`, `description`, `exclusive`                                                                                                         |
| `label_update`         | write                | Renames or recolours a label or changes its description.                                                                                                                                                                                              | `id`, `name`, `color`, `description`, `exclusive`, `archived`                                                                                       |
| `label_delete`         | destructive, confirm | Deletes a label; it is removed from all issues. Requires confirmation.                                                                                                                                                                                | `id`                                                                                                                                                |
| `milestone_list`       | read                 | Lists milestones with progress (open/closed issue counts) and due dates.                                                                                                                                                                              | `state`, `name`, `limit`, `page`                                                                                                                    |
| `milestone_create`     | write                | Creates a milestone with optional description and due date.                                                                                                                                                                                           | `title`, `description`, `due_on`                                                                                                                    |
| `milestone_update`     | write                | Edits a milestone or closes/reopens it.                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `id`, `title`, `description`, `due_on`, `state`                                                                                                     |
| `milestone_delete`     | destructive, confirm | Deletes a milestone (issues stay but lose the milestone). Requires confirmation.                                                                                                                                                                      | `id`                                                                                                                                                |

## Projects (kanban boards)

| Tool                    | Access               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                       | Parameters                                                                 |
| ----------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `project_list`          | read                 | Lists the projects (kanban boards) of a repository, an organisation or your user account, with issue counts.                                                                                      | `scope`, `org`, `state`                                                    |
| `project_get`           | read                 | Shows a project board: its columns in order and the issues and pull requests in each column. Use it to answer "what is in progress / what is left".                                               | `scope`, `org`, `id`, `max_issues_per_column`                              |
| `project_create`        | write                | Creates a project (kanban board) in a repository, an organisation or your user account. Use a template ("basic_kanban": To Do / In Progress / Done, "bug_triage") or pass your own column titles. | `scope`, `org`, `title`, `description`, `template`, `card_type`, `columns` |
| `project_update`        | write                | Renames a project, changes its description or card type, or closes/reopens it.                                                                                                                    | `scope`, `org`, `id`, `title`, `description`, `state`, `card_type`         |
| `project_delete`        | destructive, confirm | Deletes a project board (the issues themselves stay). Requires confirmation.                                                                                                                      | `scope`, `org`, `id`                                                       |
| `project_column_create` | write                | Adds a column to a project board, optionally with a colour and at a position (1 = leftmost; default: rightmost).                                                                                  | `scope`, `org`, `id`, `title`, `color`, `position`                         |
| `project_column_move`   | write                | Moves a column of a project board to another position (1 = leftmost), e.g. to put "Review" before "Done".                                                                                         | `scope`, `org`, `id`, `column`, `position`                                 |
| `project_column_update` | write                | Renames or recolours a column, or makes it the default column for new cards.                                                                                                                      | `scope`, `org`, `id`, `column`, `title`, `color`, `make_default`           |
| `project_column_delete` | destructive, confirm | Deletes a column from a project board; its cards move to the default column. Requires confirmation.                                                                                               | `scope`, `org`, `id`, `column`                                             |
| `project_issue_add`     | write                | Adds issues or pull requests (by number, from owner/repo) to a project board column (title or id; default column if omitted).                                                                     | `scope`, `org`, `id`, `numbers`, `column`                                  |
| `project_issue_move`    | write                | Moves issues or pull requests (by number) to another column of a project board, e.g. to "In Progress" or "Done".                                                                                  | `scope`, `org`, `id`, `numbers`, `column`                                  |
| `project_issue_remove`  | write                | Removes issues or pull requests (by number) from a project board column; the issues themselves are kept.                                                                                          | `scope`, `org`, `id`, `numbers`, `column`                                  |

## Time tracking

| Tool             | Access               | Description                                                                                                                                                                           | Parameters                                                   |
| ---------------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `time_list`      | read                 | Lists tracked time with totals per user: for one issue (`number`), for a whole repository, or (`mine: true`) your own entries across all repositories. Filter by user and date range. | `number`, `mine`, `user`, `since`, `before`, `limit`, `page` |
| `time_add`       | write                | Books time on an issue or pull request. Optionally backdate it (`created`) or, as a repository admin, book it for another user (`user_name`).                                         | `number`, `duration`, `created`, `user_name`                 |
| `time_delete`    | destructive, confirm | Deletes one tracked-time entry (`id`) of an issue, or with `all: true` resets all of your tracked time on that issue. Requires confirmation.                                          | `number`, `id`, `all`                                        |
| `stopwatch`      | write                | Starts the stopwatch on an issue, stops it (the elapsed time is booked as tracked time) or cancels it (discarded).                                                                    | `number`, `action`                                           |
| `stopwatch_list` | read                 | Lists your running stopwatches with the issue and the elapsed time.                                                                                                                   | –                                                            |

## Pull requests and reviews

| Tool                   | Access         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Parameters                                                                                                  |
| ---------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pr_list`              | read           | Lists pull requests filtered by state, base branch, labels, milestone or author, with sorting.                                                                                                                                               | `state`, `base_branch`, `labels`, `milestone`, `poster`, `sort`, `limit`, `page`                            |
| `pr_get`               | read           | Returns a pull request with description, branches, mergeability, reviewers and change counts. Use pr_diff for the patch and pr_merge_check for merge readiness. Pass number 0 or omit it to get the most recently updated open pull request. | `number`                                                                                                    |
| `pr_create`            | write          | Opens a pull request from `head` into `base` (default: the default branch). For a branch in a fork use "owner:branch" as head. Push local branches first with local_branch_push.                                                             | `head`, `base`, `title`, `body`, `draft`, `assignees`, `reviewers`, `team_reviewers`, `labels`, `milestone` |
| `pr_update`            | write          | Edits title, description, base branch, assignees, labels, milestone or state of a pull request.                                                                                                                                              | `number`, `title`, `body`, `base`, `assignees`, `labels`, `milestone`, `state`, `allow_maintainer_edit`     |
| `pr_close`             | write          | Closes a pull request without merging, optionally with a comment. It can be reopened with pr_update.                                                                                                                                         | `number`, `comment`                                                                                         |
| `pr_diff`              | read           | Returns the unified diff of a pull request with per-file addition/deletion counts. Use `files` to show only some files of large diffs.                                                                                                       | `number`, `files`, `max_chars`                                                                              |
| `pr_files`             | read           | Lists the files changed by a pull request with status and line counts.                                                                                                                                                                       | `number`, `limit`, `page`                                                                                   |
| `pr_commits`           | read           | Lists the commits contained in a pull request.                                                                                                                                                                                               | `number`, `limit`, `page`                                                                                   |
| `pr_reviews`           | read           | Lists the reviews of a pull request with their state and, optionally, their inline comments.                                                                                                                                                 | `number`, `include_comments`                                                                                |
| `pr_review_create`     | write          | Submits a review: APPROVED, REQUEST_CHANGES or COMMENT, with an overall body and optional inline comments (path + line in the new file, or old_line for removed lines). Use PENDING to create a draft review.                                | `number`, `event`, `body`, `comments`, `commit_id`                                                          |
| `pr_review_submit`     | write          | Submits a previously created PENDING review with a final verdict.                                                                                                                                                                            | `number`, `review_id`, `event`, `body`                                                                      |
| `pr_request_reviewers` | write          | Requests reviews from users and/or teams, or removes review requests.                                                                                                                                                                        | `number`, `reviewers`, `team_reviewers`, `remove`                                                           |
| `pr_merge_check`       | read           | Checks whether a pull request can be merged: open/draft state, merge conflicts, required approvals and status checks from branch protection, and change requests. Returns blockers and warnings.                                             | `number`                                                                                                    |
| `pr_merge`             | write, confirm | Merges a pull request with the chosen style (merge, rebase, rebase-merge, squash, fast-forward-only). Runs the merge readiness check first and refuses when blockers exist. Merging changes the target branch, so the user must confirm.     | `number`, `style`, `title`, `message`, `delete_branch_after_merge`, `merge_when_checks_succeed`             |
| `pr_update_branch`     | write          | Updates the head branch of a pull request with the latest changes of the base branch (merge or rebase).                                                                                                                                      | `number`, `style`                                                                                           |

| `org_list`                 | read           | Lists the organisations you belong to, or those of another user.                                                                                                                               | `username`, `limit`, `page`                                                                                         |
| `org_get`                  | read           | Returns an organisation with its teams (if visible to you) and member count.                                                                                                                   | `org`                                                                                                               |

| `org_create`               | admin          | Creates an organisation owned by you. Administrative operation.                                                                                                                                | `name`, `full_name`, `description`, `website`, `location`, `visibility`                                             |
| `org_update`               | admin, confirm | Edits organisation profile and visibility. Administrative; changing visibility needs confirmation.                                                                                             | `org`, `full_name`, `description`, `website`, `location`, `visibility`                                              |
| `team_list`                | read           | Lists the teams of an organisation with their permissions.                                                                                                                                     | `org`, `limit`, `page`                                                                                              |
| `team_get`                 | read           | Returns a team with its members and repositories.                                                                                                                                              | `org`, `team`                                                                                                       |
| `team_create`              | admin, confirm | Creates a team in an organisation. Administrative; requires confirmation.                                                                                                                      | `org`, `name`, `description`, `permission`, `includes_all_repositories`, `can_create_org_repo`, `units_map`         |
| `team_update`              | admin, confirm | Edits a team (name, description, permission, repository scope). Administrative; requires confirmation.                                                                                         | `org`, `team`, `name`, `description`, `permission`, `includes_all_repositories`, `can_create_org_repo`, `units_map` |
| `team_delete`              | admin, confirm | Deletes a team; its members lose the access granted through it. Administrative; requires confirmation.                                                                                         | `org`, `team`                                                                                                       |
| `team_member_set`          | admin, confirm | Adds a user to a team or removes them. Changes permissions; administrative and requires confirmation.                                                                                          | `org`, `team`, `username`, `action`                                                                                 |
| `team_repo_set`            | admin, confirm | Adds a repository to a team or removes it. Administrative; requires confirmation.                                                                                                              | `org`, `team`, `action`                                                                                             |
| `collaborator_list`        | read           | Lists the collaborators of a repository with their permission level.                                                                                                                           | `limit`, `page`                                                                                                     |
| `collaborator_set`         | admin, confirm | Adds a collaborator with a permission (read/write/admin), changes the permission, or removes the collaborator. Changes access rights; administrative and requires confirmation.                | `username`, `action`, `permission`                                                                                  |
| `repo_permissions_analyze` | read           | Shows who can access a repository: your own permission, collaborators with their levels, the owning organisation's teams with access to it, and branch protections. Useful for access reviews. | –                                                                                                                   |

## Gitea Actions

| Tool                        | Access | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Parameters                                                                    |
| --------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `actions_workflow_list`     | read   | Lists the Gitea Actions workflows of a repository with their state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | –                                                                             |
| `actions_workflow_get`      | read   | Returns a workflow and its YAML configuration file.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `workflow`, `ref`                                                             |
| `actions_run_list`          | read   | Lists Gitea Actions workflow runs, newest first, filtered by status (e.g. failure, success, in_progress), branch, event, actor, commit or workflow.                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `workflow`, `status`, `branch`, `event`, `actor`, `head_sha`, `limit`, `page` |
| `actions_run_get`           | read   | Returns a workflow run with its status, conclusion and jobs (including steps).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `run_id`                                                                      |
| `actions_job_logs`          | read   | Returns the log of a job: lines that look like errors and the last `tail_lines` lines (or the full log).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `job_id`, `tail_lines`, `full`, `max_chars`                                   |
| `actions_failures_analyze`  | read   | Finds the most recent failed Gitea Actions runs and, for each, the failed jobs and steps plus the error lines and tail of their logs. Use for "show/analyse the failed Actions runs".                                                                                                                                                                   | `branch`, `workflow`, `max_runs`, `tail_lines`                                |
| `actions_workflow_dispatch` | write  | Starts a workflow that has a workflow_dispatch trigger on a branch or tag, with optional inputs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `workflow`, `ref`, `inputs`                                                   |
| `actions_run_rerun`         | write  | Re-runs a whole workflow run, only its failed jobs, or a single job.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `run_id`, `mode`, `job_id`                                                    |
| `actions_run_cancel`        | write  | Cancels a queued or running workflow run.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `run_id`                                                                      |
| `actions_artifact_list`     | read   | Lists artifacts of a workflow run, or of the whole repository.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `run_id`, `name`, `limit`                                                     |
| `actions_artifact_download` | read   | Downloads an artifact as a zip file into the working directory (default: ./artifacts/<name>.zip). Does not overwrite existing files unless `overwrite` is true.                                                                                                                                                                                         | `artifact_id`, `output_path`, `overwrite`                                     |
| `actions_runner_list`       | read   | Lists the Actions runners that can pick up jobs of a repository, an organisation (org) or your user account: runners registered at that level plus those inherited from the owner (user or organisation) and the whole instance (visible to admins), with status, labels and whether they are busy. Use it to find out why a workflow run stays queued. | `scope`, `org`                                                                |

## Releases

| Tool                     | Access               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Parameters                                                                                              |
| ------------------------ | -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `release_list`           | read                 | Lists releases (newest first), optionally excluding drafts or pre-releases.                                                                                                                                                        | `draft`, `prerelease`, `include_body`, `limit`, `page`                                                  |
| `release_get`            | read                 | Returns a release by id, tag name, or "latest" with notes and assets.                                                                                                                                                              | `release`                                                                                               |
| `release_notes_generate` | read                 | Generates Markdown release notes for a tag (or a target branch/commit that will be tagged) from the commits since the previous release, grouped by Conventional Commit type. Does not change anything.                             | `tag`, `target`, `previous_tag`, `include_prereleases`                                                  |
| `release_create`         | write                | Creates a release for a tag. If the tag does not exist it is created on `target` (default branch). Set generate_notes to build the notes from commits since the previous release. Use draft or prerelease for unfinished versions. | `tag`, `target`, `name`, `body`, `generate_notes`, `previous_tag`, `draft`, `prerelease`, `tag_message` |
| `release_update`         | write                | Edits a release: title, notes, tag, target, draft or pre-release flag (e.g. publish a draft).                                                                                                                                      | `release`, `name`, `body`, `tag`, `target`, `draft`, `prerelease`                                       |
| `release_delete`         | destructive, confirm | Deletes a release and its assets (the git tag is kept unless delete_tag is set). Requires confirmation.                                                                                                                            | `release`, `delete_tag`                                                                                 |
| `release_asset_list`     | read                 | Lists the files attached to a release.                                                                                                                                                                                             | `release`                                                                                               |
| `release_asset_upload`   | write                | Uploads a local file (inside the working directory) as an asset of a release.                                                                                                                                                      | `release`, `file`, `name`                                                                               |
| `release_asset_delete`   | destructive, confirm | Deletes a file attached to a release. Requires confirmation.                                                                                                                                                                       | `release`, `asset_id`                                                                                   |
| `release_compare`        | read                 | Compares two releases (default: the latest two published releases): commits between them grouped by type, changed files and both release notes.                                                                                    | `base`, `head`, `include_prereleases`                                                                   |

## Packages

| Tool                     | Access               | Description                                                                                                                                                      | Parameters                             |
| ------------------------ | -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `package_list`           | read                 | Lists the packages (all registries: npm, container, maven, generic, …) of a user or organisation.                                                                | `type`, `query`, `limit`, `page`       |
| `package_get`            | read                 | Shows a package: without `version` all its versions; with `version` (or "latest") that version and its files with sizes and SHA-256 checksums.                   | `type`, `name`, `version`              |
| `package_upload_generic` | write                | Publishes a local file (inside the working directory) as a file of a generic package version in the Gitea package registry. Needs the token scope write:package. | `name`, `version`, `file`, `file_name` |
| `package_link`           | write                | Links a package to a repository of the same owner (shown on the repository page), or removes the link.                                                           | `type`, `name`, `action`               |
| `package_delete`         | destructive, confirm | Deletes one package version, or (without `version`) the whole package with all versions. Requires confirmation.                                                  | `type`, `name`, `version`              |

## Wiki

| Tool               | Access               | Description                                                                                           | Parameters                                |
| ------------------ | -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `wiki_page_list`   | read                 | Lists the wiki pages of a repository with their last change.                                          | –                                         |
| `wiki_page_get`    | read                 | Reads a wiki page (Markdown) by title or URL name, optionally with its revision history.              | `page`, `include_history`, `max_chars`    |
| `wiki_page_create` | write                | Creates a wiki page with Markdown content. The repository wiki is enabled by creating its first page. | `title`, `content`, `message`             |
| `wiki_page_update` | write                | Replaces the content of a wiki page and/or renames it (new_title).                                    | `page`, `content`, `new_title`, `message` |
| `wiki_page_delete` | destructive, confirm | Deletes a wiki page (its history stays in the wiki repository). Requires confirmation.                | `page`                                    |

| Tool                     | Access         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Parameters                                                                          |

| `webhook_list`           | read           | Lists the webhooks of a repository or organisation. Secrets are never shown.                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `org`                                                                               |
| `webhook_create`         | admin, confirm | Creates a webhook that sends events to an HTTPS URL. Administrative operation; requires confirmation because repository data is sent to an external system.                                                                                                                                 | `org`, `url`, `type`, `content_type`, `secret`, `events`, `branch_filter`, `active` |
| `webhook_update`         | admin, confirm | Edits a webhook (URL, events, branch filter, active state, secret). Administrative; requires confirmation.                                                                                                                                                                                  | `org`, `id`, `url`, `content_type`, `secret`, `events`, `branch_filter`, `active`   |
| `webhook_delete`         | admin, confirm | Deletes a webhook. Administrative; requires confirmation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `org`, `id`                                                                         |
| `webhook_test`           | write          | Triggers a test delivery of a repository webhook (sends the latest push event).                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `id`                                                                                |
| `notification_list`      | read           | Lists your notifications (unread by default), optionally for one repository or subject type.                                                                                                                                                                                                | `all`, `subject_type`, `since`, `limit`, `page`                                     |
| `notification_mark_read` | write          | Marks one notification thread, or all notifications (optionally of one repository), as read.                                                                                                                                                                                                | `thread_id`                                                                         |
| `repo_analyze`           | read           | Produces an overview of a repository: metadata, languages, activity (last commit), open issues and pull requests, latest release, branch protection, recent Actions results and the presence of README, LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY and CI configuration, with improvement suggestions. | –                                                                                   |
